newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil foreign reserves at $60.3 bln by end July.
newsitem.headline: Brazil foreign reserves at $60.3 bln by end July.

text.p: Brazil's foreign reserves, according to the international liquidity concept, rose to $60.3 billion by the end of July, a Central Bank spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said this was a "record" for the foreign reserves though Central Bank figures put the level of reserves last November a notch higher at $60.471 billion.
The international liquidity concept includes accounts receivable.
In June, the reserves slipped to $57.615 billion from $59.279 billion the month before, according to the international liquidity concept.
